questions.q: Which of the following is a benefit of division of work?
questions.x: Division of work leads to higher efficiency because people can focus on specific tasks and become skilled.

questions.q: Fayol said division of work applies to:
questions.x: Fayol applied division of work to all kinds of work, technical as well as managerial.

questions.q: A foreman must make 200 units a day but cannot requisition tools. Which principle is ignored?
questions.x: He has responsibility for the target but no authority to arrange the resources.

questions.q: Responsibility without authority results in:
questions.x: Without authority a manager cannot act on the duty given, so work suffers and morale falls.

questions.q: Which of these does NOT support good discipline?
o: Rules applied only to junior staff
questions.x: Discipline needs rules that apply to everyone, including managers.

questions.q: A company gives warning letters to repeated latecomers. Which principle is it following?
questions.x: Enforcing rules with fair penalties is discipline.

questions.q: A salesman gets different instructions from the sales manager and the finance manager. Which principle is violated?
questions.x: He is receiving orders from two superiors.

questions.q: Which technique of Taylor goes against unity of command?
questions.x: In functional foremanship a worker takes orders from eight specialist foremen.

questions.q: The whole marketing team follows one plan under one marketing head. Which principle is this?
questions.x: A group of activities with a common objective has one head and one plan.

questions.q: Unity of direction relates to:
o: A group of activities with the same objective
questions.x: It is about grouping related activities under one plan and one head.

questions.q: When an employee's interest clashes with the organisation's, which one comes first?
questions.x: General interest prevails, with management reconciling the two.

questions.q: Which of these helps apply this principle?
o: Firmness and good example by superiors
questions.x: Firmness, good example, fair agreements and supervision reconcile interests.

questions.q: Remuneration should satisfy:
questions.x: Fayol wanted just and equitable pay that gives maximum satisfaction to both sides.

questions.q: Which of these is a non-financial incentive?
questions.x: Recognition, security and growth are non-financial incentives.

questions.q: Decentralisation means:
o: Systematic dispersal of authority to lower levels
All decisions taken by the owner
questions.x: Authority is spread down to lower levels in a planned way.

questions.q: A gang plank is used:
o: For direct contact between same-level employees in an emergency
To remove the chain of authority
questions.x: A gang plank is an emergency shortcut between same-level employees. Their superiors must be informed.

questions.q: Which notes ceased to be legal tender under demonetisation?
Which is an advantage of a division?
o: Its profit or loss can be measured
Only one marketing team for all
